name: Cryptocurrency and digital assets
one_line: The digital-asset situation on the Finance schema: what a person keeps because they hold cryptocurrency or tokens - exchange account statements, transaction-history exports, deposit and withdrawal confirmations, staking and reward statements, gain-loss reports produced by a tax tool, and the on-chain receipts and wallet screenshots that document a transfer. Recommended institution, then record_type, with tax_year as an optional leaf only where a document carries its own labelled tax-year slot. Its defining privacy rule is a REFUSAL, not a filing: a seed phrase, recovery sheet, private key or keystore is credential-bearing identity material and is never a finance record here.
design_cite: PROPOSAL, and the label matters: 00 never names cryptocurrency, digital assets, wallets or exchanges anywhere. What is 00's, quoted verbatim, is the vocabulary this row reuses - "Finance files may use institution, account type, tax year, and record type" - and the posture it inherits - "Finance, identity, medical, and legal material should be implemented first as safety domains, meaning the system detects and protects them before any cloud or automated placement decision is allowed." 00 sizes the library this row belongs to ("common organizational situations such as academic programs, university applications, recruiting processes, client engagements, research workflows, financial records, travel, legal matters, creative projects, software repositories, personal administration, and photo collections") and states what a template row owes: "Each template should define the domain’s allowed fact fields, detection signals, recommended folder dimensions, preferred dimension order, optional branch patterns, privacy rules, and validation constraints." The credential refusal is 00's too, by naming rather than by example: "A scanned passport, tax statement, medical document, authentication key, or account record should enter a protected state immediately." Everything below that is specific to exchanges, wallets, on-chain transfers or self-custody is this row's proposal and is marked as such - no clause about digital assets is attributed to 00.
node_test_note: Tested against CONNECTION.md section 2 and KEPT, and the test is satisfied on all three clauses rather than one, which is why the row survives where a thinner 'crypto is a kind of money' framing would have failed. (a) Detection signals differ: the discriminators are a wallet-address-shaped or transaction-hash-shaped opaque string in a LABELLED destination/source/hash slot, an on-chain transfer vocabulary (send, receive, swap, stake, gas or network fee) in a labelled transaction-type column, and the ABSENCE of the settlement-date and securities-identifier pair that every other statement-shaped sibling has. (b) Recommended dimensions differ from the schema's default order: account_type is dropped from the standing levels because most material here carries no labelled account-descriptor slot at all, and 00 warns against exactly that level - "It should warn when a level produces only one child, repeats a concept already expressed in the parent, creates excessive depth, or creates a large number of tiny folders". (c) Privacy rules differ in kind, not degree: the material a person stores alongside these records includes seed phrases, recovery sheets and keystores, which are not weaker finance records but a different domain's protected material, and this row's job is to refuse them rather than file them. Nothing was invented to keep the row: no field was proposed, no dimension was added, and the self-custody gap that would most tempt a new key is recorded in open_question instead.
fields_note: Empty by contract: a template references its schema's fields and never copies them (CONNECTION.md section 3). The legal fields on any file this row recognizes are the Finance schema's - institution, account_type, tax_year, record_type - plus the schema row's proposed account_holder search-and-privacy key and the universal facts. Nothing here widens that set, and the two strings this material is full of (a wallet address, an asset ticker) are deliberately NOT fields; see open_question.

deterministic: an EXCHANGE ACCOUNT-RECORD structure: a labelled statement-period or reporting-period slot co-occurring with a labelled account slot and a labelled asset-balance table whose header cells carry an asset label beside quantity and value labels, on a document whose letterhead or page-one heading carries an organization-gazetteer hit matched at word boundary. 00 makes the labelled slot the direct-fact source - "Deterministic extractors create direct facts when the information comes from a reliable, explicit source, such as a content hash, EXIF timestamp, a document title, or a labeled form field" - and puts this material in tables: "Tables matter because resumes, forms, applications, invoices, and administrative documents often place their most useful information in cells rather than body paragraphs." R4 owns the gazetteer's contents and R6 the term patterns; this row names the rule family and writes neither a list nor a regex.

an ON-CHAIN TRANSFER structure: a labelled transaction-type column whose values are transfer-shaped (send, receive, swap, stake, reward, fee) co-occurring with a labelled destination or source column holding long opaque alphanumeric strings, or a labelled transaction-hash slot. PROPOSED, not design: 00 states the pattern-plus-context SHAPE for course codes only. The pair is the discriminator - a transfer vocabulary alone is a messaging or file-sync export, and an opaque string alone is any identifier.

the ABSENCE-PAIR discriminator against the securities sibling, stated positively so it can be tested: an asset/quantity/price/cost-basis table with NO settlement-date column and NO securities-identifier column, on a document with no custodian account number. The brokerage sibling already names this same file as the fixture that is not its own; the two rows agree on the discriminating evidence rather than each claiming it.

a spreadsheet or portal export whose header row carries asset, quantity, spot-price, fee and transaction-type labels, and - where an issuer is to be read at all - a venue or account column holding ONE value. 00's spreadsheet extractor supplies exactly these slots: "sheet names, column headers, visible cell values, table-like regions, formulas only when useful, and dates or identifiers from labeled cells."

an exchange notification email: the labelled sender slot resolving to an organization at word boundary, together with a deposit, withdrawal, order-filled or confirmation term in the labelled subject slot, and a labelled amount plus an asset label in the body. 00's email extractor yields "sender, recipients, subject, sent date, thread identifiers, message body, attachment names, and reply-chain context, while treating addresses and message content as potentially sensitive"; source_type alone never fires (see never_alone).

an explicit tax-year pattern in a LABELLED tax-year slot - a venue's year-end form, or a gain-loss report's "for tax year" heading - distinct from an export's date range, a filename token and any timestamp column. Narrow by 00's own rule: "Date candidates should be identified with explicit regular expressions and then parsed without fuzzy matching." R6 owns the pattern.

an archive whose manifest lists export-shaped or statement-shaped member names, read without unpacking - 00: "Archives should be inspected without being unpacked to disk." The manifest is the evidence; the outer archive name is not. Where the manifest also lists keystore-shaped or key-shaped members, the credential rule below governs the archive, not this situation.

the CREDENTIAL REFUSAL, written as a deterministic signal because it must fire before anything else does: a labelled recovery-phrase, seed, private-key, keystore or mnemonic slot - or an encrypted container whose structure says the same - routes to protection and to the identity credentials situation, and writes NO finance fact. 00 names the class outright in its immediate-protection sentence ("authentication key") and again in the residual definition ("sensitive isolated material such as passport scans, medical documents, account statements, visas, legal forms, or credentials"). This is the one signal on this row whose correct outcome is that this row does not fire.
needs_llm: an unlabelled prose notice from a venue about an account action - a delisting, a network migration, an account-restriction or a withdrawal-freeze letter - with no labelled period, account or transaction slot. 00 lists "unlabeled forms" and "unusual professional artifacts" among the reasons rules alone are insufficient, and scopes the call: "an LLM receives only compact evidence packets for files or groups that remain ambiguous, have multiple plausible domains, or contain language that requires interpretation."

an OCR'd screenshot of a wallet or exchange app: deciding from the OCR CONTENT that it shows an account or transfer record rather than a generic capture. 00 names the ambiguity for exactly this class of image - a PNG "may be a screenshot of a receipt, application portal, conversation, code error, or research figure" - and the format never decides it.

whether an export carrying no venue string belongs to an accepted account series, is a second venue, or is not this situation at all. That is the group-coherence question, answered from a dossier with citations: "A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown."

separating this situation from a blockchain software project. A repository can contain an addresses file, a token configuration and a transaction fixture that read exactly like holdings evidence; 00's own instruction is structural rather than semantic - "Code-related files should rely heavily on local structural evidence, including repository roots and package files, rather than forcing semantic analysis to infer a project from arbitrary code text" - so the model is asked only where the structural markers are absent or contradictory.

a spreadsheet with no header row and columns of asset-shaped tokens and bare numbers: whether it is a personal holdings sheet at all. 00 names "a spreadsheet with unclear purpose" among the material that reaches residual review, and it is a needs_llm case before it is a residual one.

a multilingual or non-domestic venue's record whose document-kind term has no gazetteer entry and whose slots are unlabelled; 00 names "multilingual documents" among the cases fixed patterns cannot capture.

a document that discusses an asset rather than reporting a holding - a research note, a whitepaper, a pitch deck. 00's ranking discipline applies rather than first-match acceptance: "It should rank candidate matches instead of accepting the first match".
never_alone: an asset ticker or a short uppercase token alone. This is this node's tempting-false rule and it is worse here than on the securities sibling, because the same three-to-five-letter shape is an airline or airport code, a gene symbol, a standards abbreviation, a project initialism, a currency code and a file-naming stub at once - which is why 00 requires that "It should use word-boundary matching rather than substring matching". A ticker means a holding only beside a labelled quantity, value or transaction-type slot.

a long opaque alphanumeric string alone, read as a wallet address or a transaction hash. The same shape is a content hash, an API key, a session token, a UUID, an order id, a git commit, a licence key and a device serial; each needs its own labelled slot, and reading one as a wallet address is how a credentials file gets filed as a money record.

an exchange, venue or protocol name alone. 00's ambiguity sentence is the reason - "Columbia can appear as an authoring school, course provider, target institution, employer, research venue, or merely a cited organization" - and a venue name is equally an employer on a resume, a cited organization in a news PDF, a sponsor on a conference deck, and a dependency in a package manifest.

a money figure, a quantity or a percentage alone. An offer letter states compensation, a grant states shares, a research note quotes returns, a receipt states a total; the figure discriminates nothing, and certainly not which finance situation this is.

a bare 4-digit token read as tax_year, from a filename, an export range, a quarter label or a timestamp column. 00: documents contain "numbers that look like years but are course identifiers, version numbers, build numbers, ZIP codes, or other unrelated values". Only a labelled tax-year slot fills tax_year here.

a source_type of spreadsheet, email, image, ocr, archive, code_structured or opaque_binary alone. 00: the engine should "treat the file extension as a routing signal rather than an assumption about meaning" - a .csv is not a transaction export, a .json is not a keystore, a .zip is not a wallet backup.

membership in a download session that bundled several files from one venue's portal. 00: "A session should never be treated as proof of topic" - here it is precisely the clue that would wrongly absorb an unreadable export, or a neighbouring person's export, into an accepted series.

a venue's export filename stem on a file whose content cannot be read. 00 says the system "should not infer a purpose from their filename alone" for unreadable, encrypted, corrupted or unsupported files - and a stem is the ONLY thing an encrypted wallet file offers.

the absence of EXIF on an image of a balance screen, read as proof it is a screenshot. 00: "the system must not mistake the absence of EXIF for proof that an image is a screenshot", and "conflicting signals should lead to abstention rather than an invented classification".

an asset-shaped token inside a source file, a package manifest, a configuration file or a test fixture. That is the code seam: 00 instructs that code files be read from "repository roots and package files", and "It should also reject descendants of software project roots indicated by files such as package.json, requirements.txt, Cargo.toml, or go.mod."

a transaction-type vocabulary alone, with no opaque destination string and no labelled amount. Send, receive and transfer are the vocabulary of a file-sync log, a messaging export and a shipping notice as much as of a ledger.
recognition.proposed_context_terms_note: PROPOSED, not design. 00 states the pattern-plus-context SHAPE for course codes only ("a course-code pattern together with academic context"); these are this node's candidate context terms for R6 to own. The last one is listed because it is the term whose correct outcome is a REFUSAL to fire this situation, not a match. No regex, no list contents, no threshold is written here.

work_types: gain-loss or cost-basis report from a tax tool
year-end tax form issued by a venue
token or collectible purchase and sale record
work_types_note: These are VALUES of the schema's record_type field, discovered at runtime, never roster nodes. 00: "The system may create new values when it sees a new course, project, company, university, or event, but it should not invent new fields automatically." Venue-specific and jurisdiction-specific form names are values from R5's one-jurisdiction catalogue (D4) - never field names, never dimensions. Note what is ABSENT from this list on purpose: a seed phrase, a recovery sheet, a private key and a keystore are not record_type values, because they are not records of this domain at all.
grouping_reasons: one account at one venue across its statement or export series - the repeating export header plus a stable masked account tail is the anchor, never the venue name alone

one tax year: the venue's year-end forms, the tax tool's gain-loss report and the exports that fed it. Multi-membership with the finance.tax-filings situation, never a copied fact - 00: "A file may validly belong to more than one accepted group"
one transfer across its confirmation email, its on-chain receipt and the export row that reports it
one venue-migration or account-closure event across the withdrawal confirmations and the closing statement that document it
one export re-downloaded, or a corrected report re-issued - the universal duplicate_family and version_family facts, never a finance fact
a shared record supporting two purposes - a gain-loss report inside a tax-year packet and inside an accepted account series. Multi-membership, never a copied fact

template.why: institution first, because a record_type value such as statement or confirmation is unintelligible without knowing which venue issued it - 00's own parent-dimension rule, stated for coursework and general in form: "A work type such as Homework 3 is meaningful only after the course is known, and a course code may require the school or term to disambiguate it." record_type second, as the leaf that separates statements from exports, confirmations, reward statements and reports. WHAT DIFFERS FROM THE SCHEMA'S DEFAULT ORDER, and why: account_type is dropped from the standing levels. On the schema row it earns its place because one bank runs several products for one person and a labelled account descriptor sits on the statement; most material here carries no labelled account-descriptor slot at all, so the level would open a branch the facts cannot fill and would produce a single child for most people - 00: "It should warn when a level produces only one child, repeats a concept already expressed in the parent, creates excessive depth, or creates a large number of tiny folders", and "It should recommend flattening when a dimension does not materially improve retrieval." tax_year is destination_eligible on the canonical row and is likewise not a standing level; year-first as a whole-branch order stays the tax-filings sibling's - "For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders." OPTIONAL BRANCH PATTERNS, all three of them 00's "each branch should offer the dimensions that are actually present in its member groups": (a) a tax_year leaf UNDER record_type for the year-scoped subset that carries its own labelled tax-year slot - venue year-end forms, gain-loss reports - never above institution and never filled from an export range, a quarter label or a filename token; (b) account_type restored between institution and record_type, returning to the schema's default order, where a labelled account-descriptor slot genuinely exists on the records - a retirement-wrapped or corporate account at the same venue is the case that asks for it; (c) NO institution level at all for the self-custody subset, because there is no issuing organization to name and inventing one would be a fabricated fact - that material sits at record_type under the parent, or under a scoped fallback of the kind 00 describes for a file with a meaningful parent and no recoverable child value ("the future tree can include Academics/Columbia/2026-Spring/General rather than sending it to a global Unsorted folder"). Safety posture: shallow by intent. This is a recommendation over a protected area, not a filing tree - "a Finance or Identity proposal may be visible as a protected area, but the product should avoid showing sensitive filenames or sending their contents to cloud services by default". A folder level named for a wallet address would publish an identifier on the filesystem, which is why no such level exists and no such key was proposed. The user may reverse, remove, add, or flatten all of it: "The system recommends an order based on the domain template, but the user can reverse, remove, add, or flatten dimensions." account_holder, the schema row's proposed search-and-privacy key, is never a dimension - "It should avoid using authorship or creator identity as a destination dimension."

file_kinds.note: code_structured and .json are listed because this material genuinely arrives in those shapes (an export, a wallet metadata file) - and they are the two entries most likely to be misread, which is why the never_alone list carries a rule for each. A .json is a keystore, a package manifest, a notebook, a config and an API response before it is anything of this domain's.

OCR of the frame returns a numbered list of twelve common words and a labelled heading reading Recovery Phrase

must_not_conclude: ANY finance fact. This is the refusal fixture and the reason this row exists in the shape it does: the material sits beside a person's exchange statements and is not a record of an account. It is credential-bearing identity material - 00's immediate-protection sentence names "authentication key" in the same breath as "account record", and the identity.credentials-passwords situation owns it
record_type = anything. There is no record here; there is a key

the OCR'd words retained as a normalized value, surfaced in a group summary, or included in any dossier - 00: "Paths, complete extracted text, OCR output, file hashes, image EXIF, GPS, user edits, group memberships, and raw sensitive values should remain local", and "Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default"

that camera EXIF makes this a photo event, or that the photos co-activation makes this filable. The capture facts stand on their own evidence and settle nothing about what the frame contains; the identity.credentials-passwords situation owns this file and its own row carries the same fixture.

a folder path - and specifically not a deep one; 00: "Rare but sensitive files such as passports, visas, and legal documents may be surfaced as protected records even when they do not meet a normal group-size threshold."

observations: geth's own keystore naming convention: an ISO timestamp run concatenated with the derived wallet address, so an address-shaped opaque string sits in the FILENAME
the file parses as JSON and two members are readable plaintext - a version number and an address field; every secret sits inside a crypto object whose cipher, kdf and mac members are encrypted blobs
no organization string, no period, no amount, no account descriptor anywhere
arrived in the same download session as a readable export
must_not_conclude: ANY finance fact. A keystore is a key. 00's own default for this class is metadata-only: "disk images, executables, databases, encrypted containers, damaged files, and unknown binary formats should default to safe metadata-only indexing unless a dedicated extractor has been explicitly approved"

the readable address member, or the address run in the filename, retained as a value. This is the hardest temptation on the node - the string is plaintext, it is in a labelled slot, and it is stable across files - and there is no field for it; reading it as an account identity is how a private key becomes a filed money record
institution or record_type from the filename stem alone - 00: the system "should not infer a purpose from their filename alone" for unreadable files
membership in the accepted account series because the download session bundled it; a session is a possible-grade clue only
that .json makes it code or data; source_type is a routing signal and never alone, and the readable JSON skin here wraps an encrypted container
a folder path

observations: page-one heading carries a report name and a labelled tax-year slot reading 2025
a labelled short-term and long-term split with proceeds and cost-basis columns
the letterhead names a tax-software product, not a venue; a later section lists three venue names as data sources
a masked taxpayer identification slot in the recipient block
must_not_conclude: institution = the tax-software product from the letterhead. The tool produced the document and issued no account; and institution must not be filled from the three venue names in the sources section either, because the report belongs to none of them singly. This is the ugly case on this node: the strongest positional evidence is the wrong role

a jurisdiction field, or a field named after this report or a form - names are VALUES of record_type from R5's one-jurisdiction catalogue (D4); a field named for a form is the one-way move the contract forbids
account_type; the report aggregates across venues and describes no single account
that belonging to the accepted tax-year filing packet removes it from the venue account series - one file in two groups, never a fact copied between them

must_not_conclude: media_type = screenshot from the missing EXIF alone; the exact display resolution and the filename pattern are what may support it, and "conflicting signals should lead to abstention rather than an invented classification"
the balance or any holding size retained as a fact, and no truncated address retained as a value - this is protected material that must not reach a cloud prompt
that it is a member of the accepted account series because it names the same app; it may join the account neighbourhood without carrying the statement's facts

a deploy script in the same tree references a token address constant

must_not_conclude: member facts written onto the archive, or the archive's facts written onto members - 00's mixed-manifest shape; the manifest is evidence of a candidate set for review

institution from the archive name

labelled subject slot carries an order term and an order-shaped identifier

that the device purchase evidences ownership of any holding
a folder path

collides_with.signal: an exchange export and a securities export share asset, quantity, price, fee and cost-basis columns slot for slot. The discriminating evidence: a securities identifier plus a settlement date under a custodian account number is the brokerage situation; a labelled destination or transaction-hash slot holding an opaque address-shaped string, an on-chain transfer vocabulary, and NO settlement date is this one. The asset/quantity/price triple is the item that must not count for both. Reciprocates the edge already authored on finance.investment-brokerage, and names the same fixture from this side: exchange_transactions_2025.csv.

the sharpest and most consequential collision on this row. A wallet keystore, a recovery-phrase photograph and an encrypted wallet container arrive in the same folder, the same archive and the same download session as this situation's statements and exports, and a venue name or a wallet-tool stem sits on both. The discriminating evidence: a labelled account, period, amount or transaction-type structure REPORTING on holdings is this situation; a labelled recovery-phrase, seed, private-key, keystore or mnemonic slot, or an encrypted container whose structure says the same, is credential material and this situation must not fire at all. One evidence item - the venue name, the wallet-tool filename stem - must never count for both, and getting it wrong is not a misfiling but an exposure. Fixtures: recovery phrase backup.jpg, UTC--2026-02-11T14-22-08.331Z--3f5c...9ad1.json, wallet_backup.zip.

a venue's year-end form and a tax tool's gain-loss report carry an explicit labelled tax-year slot - the filing situation's own strongest signal. The discriminating evidence: a labelled tax-year slot read as the year's return support is the filing situation; the same document read as a venue account's year-end record, tied to a masked account tail in an accepted series, is this one. The YEAR is the single evidence item that must not count for both. The file legitimately belongs to two accepted groups; that is multi-membership, never a copied fact. Fixture: Crypto Tax Report 2025.pdf.

a purchase paid in a digital asset, and a retail purchase OF wallet hardware, both read as this situation. The discriminating evidence: an asset label plus a transfer or account structure is this situation; a merchant, a line item and an order total with no asset and no account is a receipt. The money figure and the merchant name are the items that must not count for both. Fixture: Order confirmation - hardware wallet.eml.

a blockchain repository contains address-shaped constants, asset tokens, amounts and export-shaped test fixtures - this situation's evidence vocabulary, inside code. The discriminating evidence is structural and 00 names it: a repository root or package manifest in the directory tree makes the file code, and no amount of asset-shaped content overrides that. Fixture: hardhat.config.ts.

a screenshot of a wallet app and any other screenshot share the absence of EXIF, an exact display resolution and the platform filename pattern. The discriminating evidence is only the OCR content: an app name beside a labelled balance and an address fragment is an account record; capture properties with no such structure are a capture only. 00 forbids reading missing EXIF as proof either way. Fixtures: Screenshot 2026-05-11 at 21.03.44.png, IMG_5502.png.

an operation that accepts digital-asset payment keeps exports that are simultaneously its ledger source. The discriminating evidence: a venue account or on-chain transfer structure is this situation; a ledger sheet with invoice numbers, client names and a chart-of-accounts column is bookkeeping. The transaction rows are the item that must not count for both.

also_holds_with_note: Empty by contract, not by omission: CONNECTION.md section 5 restricts also_holds_with to schema-to-schema pairs, and this is a template row. It is the home for BOTH halves of this node: the isolated venue statement with no accepted series, and the credential material this row refuses to file as a record. role_split_note: Empty deliberately. role_split lives between canonical FIELD keys (CONNECTION.md sections 5 and 6), and the split this material needs most - the venue that ISSUED a record against the tax tool or software that PRODUCED it, both of which sit in a page-one letterhead - has no canonical counterpart key to split against. It is recorded in must_not_conclude on Crypto Tax Report 2025.pdf rather than minted here, because minting a producer-side key to solve one template's problem is the move that produced 2,295 private field names in the overnight pass. The finance schema row's existing splits (institution against school, institution against target_university) apply unchanged.
sensitivity_why: 00 names this material inside its privacy sentence - the corpus "can include identity documents, account statements, tax records, medical information, legal records, credentials, private correspondence, GPS metadata, employment materials, and educational records" - and requires immediate protection: "A scanned passport, tax statement, medical document, authentication key, or account record should enter a protected state immediately." Both of that sentence's relevant nouns land on this one node at once, which is what makes it different from its siblings: an exchange statement is an "account record", and the seed phrase in the next file along is an "authentication key". "Protected material should not be included in cloud-model prompts by default", and the canvas shows it as a protected area: "a Finance or Identity proposal may be visible as a protected area, but the product should avoid showing sensitive filenames or sending their contents to cloud services by default." Only 00's phrase is asserted; the handling class is P7's and is not set here. Two consequences this row records rather than invents: a folder level named for a wallet address would publish an identifier on the filesystem, so no such level and no such key exists; and a recovery phrase is one of the few file contents whose disclosure is itself the harm, so its OCR text is evidence that stays local and never a normalized value - 00: "Paths, complete extracted text, OCR output, file hashes, image EXIF, GPS, user edits, group memberships, and raw sensitive values should remain local."
open_question: Self-custody has no institution, and nothing in the canonical vocabulary can say so. The Finance schema gives institution the ISSUER role, and a person holding assets in their own wallet has no issuing organization at all - so under this row's recommended order, a real and common half of this material cannot open the first level, while the exchange half opens it cleanly. The three answers are different products: (a) the self-custody subset carries no institution fact and sits at record_type or under a scoped fallback, which is what this row recommends today and what optional branch pattern (c) encodes; (b) a custody-mode distinction is read into account_type, which makes that field carry a meaning it was not defined to carry and would merge two people's very different arrangements; (c) an account-identity or custody key is minted on the shared vocabulary, which is a decision about the product's field table and must not be made by one template row - and which would immediately raise whether a wallet identifier may ever be a folder level, where this row's answer is no. Recorded, not resolved: no field was proposed here. A second, smaller fork rides on the same answer - whether an encrypted wallet container's residual home is Protected Records (00 names "credentials") or Unsupported or Encrypted (00 names the format) - and this row states its preference and its reason in falls_through_to rather than treating it as settled.
